items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: The name 'Mary' appears only in the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn: 'Mary said, oh, the Lord said...'. The interviewee does not mention Mary, nor does he respond to or acknowledge a relationship with her.

ctx.x: All I can tell you during the district, when we young men like that go around there, the police will take a strap. When I'm 68 years old at present, and I just called almost the last part of the district. I wouldn't tell you a lie that I played in the district, but I know about it. And we go around there, they just take, with being boys, they take this strap and they beat you on your backside and chase you out. They know what you do is just scare you. And we respect men to them days, you understand? It's not any…

When I went over there, ooh, I just went over to the base and looked at all them pretty people past. I said, Jesus Christ, I want to be 21 years old. But I didn't call it. You know what I mean? Mary said, oh, the Lord said, oh, he's a man now. Yeah, he's a boy. Oh, Jesus Christ. I said, I want to go by his daddy and lose some to all the first jobs and playing. I was a young fellow there too, you know. But otherwise, you know, I never let no girls then know. I was busy with music. I didn't like them. And then…

I like one. You see, in my time, I know Jim as old as I am, when we go to the balls, you remember we were talking to the great economy hall. And they like that number stumbling. I'm going to bring you to around 21 and 22. Them numbers come out. We go to them big balls, like the church, you heard the Jim was giving the festival. Sam up there playing the music. I don't know if you're stuck about that. I'm up there watching Alfred on the drum and looking at the band play that number. You understand? And the rest of…
